rounds.notes: Found a manual-refresh failure path that depended on SSE reconnection to restore the disabled Refresh button. Added an explicit catch-path reset and regression coverage; test:ci-health and verify:fast passed.

The reviewer confirmed round 1 was resolved, then identified the unfinished ledger plus three additional lifecycle/error-path concerns: refresh-action close races, SSE disconnect while refreshing, and structured 502 diagnostics being overwritten. All three code paths now have explicit guards or recovery behavior and regression coverage; test:ci-health passes 19/19 and verify:fast passes. The two-round model cap prevents a third independent model verification pass, so final acceptance is escalated to the human.

escalated_to_human.reason: The bounded two-round code-review loop ended with new concerns in round 2. Their fixes are implemented and locally green, but policy requires human attention rather than a third model round.
